text:
Omar (Support): FYI hitting a surge of failed activations for a subset of trials — need CS handback ASAP. 43 failures in last hour, retries spamming support queue.

Maya (CS): On it. Which accounts are most affected and what's the failure mode?

Omar (Support): Mostly trial tier customers started onboarding yesterday. Errors look like provisioning 403 from the key service, plus a spike in token errors. Example log snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-23T18:45:12Z provisioning: create-seat failed account=solstice-health id=acc_7f3e msg="provisioning quota exceeded" code=403
```
Also seeing repeated webhook retries causing duplicate tasks. Link to support search: https://redwood/support/search?q=192345

Maya (CS): Thanks. I'll scope outreach and own comms. Can eng confirm whether this is quota/ratelimit vs key rotation? Need estimate for customer-facing ETA.

Alex (Eng): Investigating. Initial read: quota throttling plus an unexpected backpressure loop in the provisioning service. Not a key rotation this time. I can push a config change to relax burst limits for the affected pool and throttle retries at the edge. If approved, hotfix rollout ~30m.

Priya (CS): Comms plan proposal: 1) Immediate: short acknowledgment to impacted accounts that we're investigating and pausing automated retries to reduce noise. 2) Near-term (within 3h): provide ETA & temporary workaround (manual seat upsert via partner UI). 3) Follow-up: root-cause note + credits if SLA hit. Draft ack (short):
"Hi — we’re seeing provisioning errors during onboarding and have paused automated retries while we fix this. We’ll update within 3 hours with an ETA and a workaround. Apologies for the interruption; your onboarding progress won’t be lost."

Omar (Support): +1 to pause retries. Which account list should I use for outbound? I can send the ack now if CS approves.

Maya (CS): Approve send. Use the high-touch list from last quarter + any trial signups in past 72h. Action items: 
- Maya: Own outbound and scheduled enablement calls (:calendar: 15:30 PST/23:30 UTC)
- Priya: Draft personalized notes & feedback capture template
- Alex: Roll config change and confirm hotfix status
- Omar: Throttle retries on support side and surface any escalations
Handback ETA: 3 hours. Next update in 30m. :thumbsup:

Alex (Eng): Starting the rollout now. I'll post deploybot updates.

DevOpsBot: deploy/provisioning-hotfix v2.1 queued by Alex. CI pipeline running.

Omar (Support): Sending initial ack to 18 impacted accounts now (examples: Solstice Health acct_7f3e, LumenVault acct_91a2). I'll add a note on the support ticket with the planned enablement time.

Priya (CS): Draft for personalized follow-up (to include team/next steps + meeting link):
"Hi <NAME>, quick update: we’ve identified a provisioning throttle affecting some trial activations. We’ve paused retries and are applying a fix. We’re scheduling a short enablement call to complete your activation manually if needed. Please pick a time in this link: <cal_link>. Thanks for your patience — we’ll also capture any feedback on the onboarding flow"

Maya (CS): Great. Make sure the feedback capture includes 2 quick questions: what step failed, and any friction in OAuth/SAML. We’ll route responses into Gainsight.

Alex (Eng): Hotfix passed smoke tests. Rolling to prod now. I’ll confirm when burst limits are adjusted.

DevOpsBot: deploy/provisioning-hotfix v2.1 succeeded.

Maya (CS): Thanks team. Omar — keep me posted on any customers that still show failed state after the fix. We’ll run the follow-up enablement calls and close loop. Next update at 19:15 UTC.

Omar (Support): Will do. Posting update to each ticket and tagging Maya/Priya.

Priya (CS): I’ll queue the enablement invites and the postmortem feedback form.

Maya (CS): Closing the triage thread for now — reopening if we see new failures. :white_check_mark:
